tweets.text:
Super bullish on WebMCP. Much like Tesla FSD meets the world where it is (streets, stoplights, potholes and all), agents *need* to ride the existing WWW infrastructure… WebMCP makes it more efficient.

Some pretty unique wins too. e.g: Next.js dev pages could expose debugging tools directly to agents in the specific tab they’re testing, with page-specific context, instead of sifting through server logs. No separate MCP server to find and configure because the page directly exposes its own 'agent tools'.

e.g: in this world 𝚏𝚡 + 𝚊𝚐𝚎𝚗𝚝-𝚋𝚛𝚘𝚠𝚜𝚎𝚛 is a complete web dev stack with zero loss in debugging depth
tweets.summary_zh:
对WebMCP的未来超级看好。就像特斯拉的自动驾驶技术能够适应现实世界（街道、红绿灯、 potholes（坑洼）），AI应用也需要基于现有的网络基础设施。WebMCP让这一切变得更高效。

举个例子，使用Next.js开发的页面可以直接向AI提供调试工具，专注于它们正在测试的特定页面，而不是在服务器日志中翻找。这样就不需要单独找和配置MCP服务器，因为页面会直接提供自己的“代理工具”。

总之，在这种环境下，结合𝚏𝚡和𝚊𝚐𝚎𝚗𝚝-𝚋𝚛𝚘𝚠𝚜𝚎𝚛，就能创建一个完整的网络开发工具组合，同时保证调试的深度不受影响。

tweets.text:
GPT-6 Astra is out. We've been testing the model in early preview on our enterprise complex work eval at Box. It is now the best model we've ever tested on our expanded and hardest test set.

Overall, GPT-6 Astra offers a breakthrough level of capability in coding, analytics, logic, and domain specific knowledge for dealing with complex enterprise knowledge work. In our eval, we use the GPT-6 Astra model in the Box Agent and give it a set of difficult tasks that represent real-world work in various industries. These tasks often will take people hours to execute properly and require deep domain expertise.

GPT-6 Astra scored 77% overall vs. 74% with GPT-5.6 Sol, representing frontier performance. But the story is in some of the bigger gains on individual task types that are incredibly complex across. Here are a few examples across the tests that show how much of an impact this will be in different industries:

* Media and entertainment (48% → 100%, +52 points). Ranking film genres and countries by profitability across a year of production data from four teams, where the trick is to apply the following year's tax-incentive corrections without double-counting them. GPT-6 Astra was perfect on every attempt. Sol had the rankings right but the underlying ratios were wrong.

* Technology (69% → 97%, +28 points). Choosing which region to fund first, from a stack of performance and infrastructure documents that never state the metric the brief asks for. GPT-6 Astra flagged the gap, labelled its own figure a proxy, and caught a growth claim that didn't match the numbers beneath it. GPT-5.6 Sol reported the proxy as the real thing.

* Legal (69% → 93%, +24 points). Reviewing an NDA against a company's own contracting policy, where reaching the right verdict isn't enough; the answer has to cite the provision behind it. Both models declined to approve the draft, but only GPT-6 Astra separated whether the liability cap's structure was permissible from whether its amount was defensible, and pointed to the policy language that settles it. GPT-5.6 Sol argued the same conclusion without citing the provision, which is a critical error in the legal industry.

* Healthcare (53% → 77%, +23 points). Auditing a batch of radiology reports for errors and rating how serious each one is. GPT-6 Astra caught a terminology error in a knee-imaging report that GPT-5.6 Sol missed on both attempts, and was more reliable at grading severity rather than just flagging that something was wrong.

* Energy (82% → 97%, +15 points). Building a consumption report on two facilities from a year of meter logs, where only one of the two sites is actually missing data. GPT-6 Astra found it and drew a line most reviewers wouldn't: the other site's odd solar readings are a measurement problem to investigate, not a gap in the record. GPT-5.6 Sol reported both sites as incomplete.

Astra clearly is going to offer a meaningful jump in powering and orchestrating enterprise workflows. We'll be making GPT-6 Astra as an option in the Box AI Studio for customers to build agents with shortly as it continues to roll out.

tweets.text:
Every AI product should be working towards abstracting model choice away from users. 

In any product, the intelligence is the underlying engine - all the user cares about is that the job gets done. 

Model picking is too much cognitive load for the user.

There have been multiple attempts to abstract model choice away from users. I think we’re finally at the point where this can work well.

It takes three things:

1/ Deep understanding of the model frontier across different weight classes for your particular use cases.

2/ Great evals for your workflows, so you know which models work best where.

3/ A team with the talent and AI-native operating model to continuously adapt as the frontier moves.

Having worked with the Lovable team, I can say they have all three.
tweets.summary_zh: 每个 AI 产品都应该努力简化用户选择模型的过程。用户最关心的是能否完成任务，而不是挑选背后的复杂模型。现在我们终于有了可能实现这一点的条件，包括对模型的深入理解、有效的评估系统和有能力的团队。我认为 Lovable 团队具备了这些条件。

Some of the core pieces you will need:

1/ a crisp definition of the various metrics you care about : primary, secondary, guardrail

2/ an articulation of your strategy, roadmap and metrics you care about moving the most

3/ knowledge base of past product decisions and principles so the agent knows how decisions get made 

4/ connections to your to your internal product systems: dashboards, APIs, MCPs, and tools your agent  needs to observe and act on your product. 

5/ a harness built with knowledge of  your end to end product development flow.

One non-model thing I'm very excited we announced today with Fable 5.1 is Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS).

Even if you're not a CEO/CISO, this blog post is a look into how big companies are thinking about AI adoption which is important to understand if you're interested in how AI might diffuse across industry.

Over the summer, we have been sprinting on safety priorities; it's more important than ever for capabilities and safeguards to advance together. We have more to do but have made a lot of progress. We are also going to be launching our next model soon.

Astra has been done training for a while now and is a significant step forward in both capabilities and alignment. For the models after that, we have been slowing things as needed to ensure that we can do sufficient work on safety and alignment.

AI is getting extremely capable; no one fully understands the consequences of this. Managing the transition to a world with abundant and powerful AI to optimize for safety and benefits to people should be one of the highest priorities in the world. It is our highest priority at OpenAI.

We have been living with the tension between being excited and anxious about progress for some time, and it is still discordant for us. We know it is much more discordant for other people. And yet, we believe strongly that the world needs to understand where AI is going and how models perform in the real world. More importantly, we believe the world will need aligned AI to manage the future phases of this transition.

An iterative loop where society and this technology evolve together is what will lead to the highest chance of getting this right.

tweets.text:
Sometimes people don’t have an intuitive sense of what Jevons paradox looks like for token consumption. Those of us working with enterprises get to see this first hand every day.

Basically enterprises have an unending stream of tasks that they’d love to be able to bring automation to. But for each individual task, it’s either ROI positive or not based on the cost of bringing automation to it (including the setup time, change management, and so on).

As tokens get cheaper (at a certain capability threshold), enterprises can afford bringing them to more of the work that they do. This could be processing every contract, reading every log, watching new streams of data for insights, having background agents execute workflows, and so on. 

Any time we can lower the cost of tokens, we will see a disproportionate increase in consumption. Even a 50% drop in token prices could result in a 5X increase in tokens for these kinds of workloads.

This is why it’s critical to keep bringing down the cost of AI, and why that’s good for all market participants.
tweets.summary_zh:
有些人不太理解“杰文斯悖论”（指的是资源变便宜时，使用量反而会急剧增加）在企业使用机器人处理工作的时候的表现。企业们总是希望能自动化更多的任务，但每个任务是否划算，主要取决于自动化的费用。

随着机器人处理成本的降低，企业能用它们来处理更多的工作，比如分析合同、查看日志、监测数据等。每当降低这些成本，就会看到使用量大幅增加，甚至价格下降50%可能导致任务使用量增加五倍。

因此，持续降低AI的成本，对所有参与者都是有益的。

AI product building has a ~3-month playbook half-life. Here’s how to adapt.

Most trad product teams are built to discover a playbook and then milk it for the next 5 years.

However in the AI labs, we consciously throw away playbooks every few months cos we start seeing diminishing returns.

Here’s what you can do as an AI builder:

Focus on defining a set of meta-principles for 
1/ how you continuously learn what the market wants today and what it might want in 3 months
2/ how you execute with extreme urgency

The specifics of 1 and 2 will vary based on your domain and product type.
Build a team that learns and adapts at that pace. 

Legacy teams are optimized for playbook milking.

AI teams need to be optimized for inventing.

tweets.text:
It's interesting to me to see a lot of people comment on visa stuff without actually going through it.

I am a proud American citizen who has also had the following visas: F1, OPT, CPT, H1-B, EB-3 Green Card etc.

I think ALL of the following things can be true:
1/ There is abuse of the H1-B system. We should 100% stop that. It prevents legitimate use cases. I am glad the government is doing something about this.

2/ We make it too hard for truly high-skilled workers to stay in the USA. It is a huge source of strength for us that the sharpest minds in the world WANT to come here. 

3/ In particular, high-skilled Indians have it harder than most. 

4/ In any country, the laws and regulations should prioritize it's own citizens.
tweets.summary_zh:
看到很多人评论关于签证的事情，却没有经历过这个过程，我觉得挺有意思的。作为一个自豪的美国公民，我也曾用过很多种签证，比如学生签证、工作签证等。

我认为以下几点都是对的：
1. H1-B签证系统确实有一些滥用现象，我们应该彻底停止这些行为，这样才能让合法的使用者受益。
2. 我们让真正高技能的工人在美国待下来的门槛太高了。世界上最聪明的人想来美国，这对我们是个很大的优势。
3. 特别是高技能的印度人面临的挑战比其他国家的人更大。
4. 各国的法律和规定应优先考虑本国公民的利益。

这个视频讨论了为什么Linux在AI代理领域中有可能超越MacOS和Windows。通过深入分析Linux的开放性和灵活性，视频论证了Linux如何为AI开发提供更强的工具和环境，吸引了越来越多的开发者和创客选择它作为首选平台。

🎯 推荐 Yves 观看 — 这个视频提供了有关AI开发环境的重要见解，可能对Logic Labs的产品开发和TexTale的创意设计工具选择有所启发。

podcasts.name: Data Driven NYC
podcasts.title: A Thousand More GPUs Would Change the World #ai #podcast
podcasts.summary_zh:
这期播客讨论了当前GPU的需求与供应状况，探讨了如果再增加1000个GPU，可能对AI技术以及整个世界带来的重要影响。嘉宾们分享了他们对AI计算能力提升后的应用场景的看法，以及在这种变革中可能出现的新机会。

🎯 推荐 Yves 观看 — 此视频深入探讨了AI技术的未来，可能与Logic Labs和TexTale在创意设计和电商运营中的发展密切相关。

podcasts.name: The AI Daily Brief
podcasts.title: How To Navigate the Next Wave of AI Competition
podcasts.summary_zh:
视频讨论了如何在新一轮的AI竞争中找到合适的导航策略，强调了企业需要不断创新和适应市场变化，以保持竞争力。节目中分析了行业趋势和最佳实践，帮助企业家们理解未来的竞争环境。

💡 值得一看 — 视频中涉及的行业趋势和竞争策略，对Yves在Logic Labs和TexTale的运营及创意设计有潜在的启发。

podcasts.name: TBPN
podcasts.title: 🔴 LIVE From CrowdStrike's Fal.Con 2026
podcasts.summary_zh:
这期直播来自CrowdStrike的Fal.Con 2026大会，主要讨论了当前网络安全领域的最新趋势和技术创新。嘉宾们分享了如何利用AI技术强化网络安全防护，探讨了未来网络威胁的应对方案，并为企业提供了实用的安全策略。

💡 值得一看 — 视频中涉及的AI安全技术和行业洞察，可能为Logic Labs在AI产品开发和TexTale的电商运营提供灵感。

podcasts.name: Every Inc
podcasts.title: FABLE 5.1 IS A BEAST
podcasts.summary_zh:
这段视频介绍了最新版的 FABLE 5.1 ，强调了其强大的功能和创新设计。视频展示了 FABLE 在处理复杂 AI 任务时的卓越性能，适合那些希望在创意设计和技术开发中提升效率的用户。

🎯 推荐 Yves 观看 — 这款工具的强大功能将有助于 Logic Labs 和 TexTale 在 AI 产品开发和创意设计中获得更多灵感和实用技巧。

podcasts.name: Every Inc
podcasts.title: We Tested Anthropic's Fable 5.1 for a Week
podcasts.summary_zh:
视频介绍了 Anthropic 的最新 AI 语言模型 Fable 5.1 的一周使用体验，通过实际测试展示了其在理解自然语言、生成文本和任务完成方面的表现和局限。视频中还探讨了该模型在用户交互中的可靠性及应用场景。

🎯 推荐 Yves 观看 — Fable 5.1 的功能可以为 Logic Labs 和 TexTale 的创意设计工作提供有价值的洞察，帮助提升品牌营销及电商运营的效率。

podcasts.name: Fireship
podcasts.title: A mysterious new model just took over the internet...
podcasts.summary_zh:
这个视频讨论了一个新出现的AI模型，该模型在网络上迅速走红，引发了广泛关注。它的能力和应用潜力正在改变人们对AI的看法，尤其是在创意和设计领域。

🎯 推荐 Yves 观看 — 这个模型可能为 Logic Labs 和 TexTale 提供新的创意设计思路和工具，帮助提升产品的创新性与市场竞争力。

producthunt.name: Clipto MCP
producthunt.tagline: Let agents source clips from terabytes of your local video
producthunt.summary_zh: Clipto MCP 是一款视频剪辑工具，允许用户从本地海量视频中快速提取片段。它支持高效整理和查找视频素材，方便用户在创作中使用。

producthunt.name: Dograh
producthunt.summary_zh: Dograh 是一个开源的 VAPI 替代方案，旨在提供灵活的 API 解决方案。用户可以使用它创建、管理和测试 API，简化开发过程，提高效率。这个工具支持多种编程语言，方便开发者集成。

producthunt.name: Astute
producthunt.tagline: Automate your B2B brand going viral, with new media creators
producthunt.summary_zh: Astute 是一个自动化平台，帮助企业与新媒体创作者合作，快速提升品牌知名度。通过简化品牌宣传流程，企业可以轻松实现内容的病毒式传播。

producthunt.name: Grok Bot
producthunt.tagline: AI teammates that you can give real work to
producthunt.summary_zh: Grok Bot是一款智能助手，可以作为你的工作搭档执行实际任务。它可以处理信息、回答问题和完成日常工作，让你更高效地完成目标。通过与Grok Bot协作，你可以节省时间和精力。

producthunt.name: Meridian
producthunt.tagline: Don't let your work go unnoticed. Get promoted!
producthunt.summary_zh: Meridian是一款专注于职业发展的工具。它可以帮助用户记录并展示自己的工作成就，让你在职场上获得更多关注和晋升机会。通过使用Meridian，你可以轻松整理和分享自己的工作亮点。

producthunt.name: x1
producthunt.tagline: Lovable for iPhone apps go from idea to App Store
producthunt.summary_zh: x1 是一个帮助用户将想法转化为 iPhone 应用的工具。它提供从概念设计到提交 App Store 的完整流程，用户可以轻松创建和发布自己的应用程序。

producthunt.name: Coldtea.ai
producthunt.summary_zh: Coldtea.ai 是一款智能软件工具，它可以自动化软件的运行和管理流程。用户只需简单设置，系统就能自主完成复杂任务，提高工作效率。

producthunt.name: Kilo Code for JetBrains
producthunt.tagline: Fully native, open-source coding agent built for JetBrains
producthunt.summary_zh: Kilo Code for JetBrains 是一款完全原生的开源编码助手，专为 JetBrains 开发环境设计。它能够提高编码效率，提供智能代码建议和自动完成功能，让开发者更轻松地编写程序。

producthunt.name: Monid
producthunt.summary_zh: Monid是一个为代理工具提供支持的开放式路由平台。它可以帮助用户快速集成和管理不同的代理工具，提升工作效率。用户可以通过Monid轻松连接和使用各种应用程序。

producthunt.name: Soloop
producthunt.tagline: Approval-first Agent OS for solo founders
producthunt.summary_zh: Soloop 是一款专为独立创始人设计的操作系统，旨在帮助他们高效管理业务流程。它通过“优先批准”的方式，简化决策和执行，提升工作效率。用户可以在平台上集中处理任务和项目，确保业务顺利推进。

producthunt.name: PaymentKit
producthunt.tagline: Billing that survives a processor shutdown
producthunt.summary_zh: PaymentKit是一款支付处理工具，能够在支付处理器出现故障时继续进行账单和交易。它确保用户的付款流程不会中断，提高了支付的可靠性和效率。

producthunt.name: Clara AI SDR
producthunt.tagline: Turn website visitors into qualified pipeline
producthunt.summary_zh: Clara AI SDR 是一款自动化的软件工具，可以将访问网站的访客转化为潜在客户。通过智能分析和交互，它能够识别有意向的访客并收集相关信息，帮助企业建立更高效的客户销售漏斗。

producthunt.name: Cloudflare OS
producthunt.tagline: Build the AI operating system for your company
producthunt.summary_zh: Cloudflare OS是一款人工智能操作系统，旨在为企业构建智能化的工作环境。它可以整合企业的数据和应用，自动化日常任务，提高团队的工作效率。用户可以通过简单的界面管理和优化业务流程。

producthunt.name: Kane CLI
producthunt.tagline: Natural language browser & mobile app tests from terminal
producthunt.summary_zh: Kane CLI 是一款命令行工具，可以通过自然语言指令执行浏览器和手机应用程序的测试。用户只需输入简单的语言描述，工具便能自动生成相应的测试脚本，提升测试效率。

producthunt.name: Skydive
producthunt.tagline: Build cloud agents that work across your tools
producthunt.summary_zh: Skydive是一个云代理构建工具，允许用户在不同的工具和平台之间创建和管理自动化流程。用户可以通过Skydive简化工作流程，实现各种任务的自动化，提高工作效率。

github_trending.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
github_trending.summary_zh: 这个项目提供了一系列实用的技能和工具，旨在帮助工程师更高效地进行开发和管理工作。对于Yves来说，虽然这个项目主要面向工程师，但它可以作为Logic Labs在AI领域工具整合的参考，帮助优化技术流程，并为TexTale的电商平台提供潜在的技术支持，提升运营效率。作为创意设计从业者，Yves也可以从中获取灵感，了解技术与创意结合的方式。

github_trending.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
github_trending.summary_zh: 这个项目是一个性能优化系统，旨在提升 AI 工具（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）的效率和智能，帮助开发者更好地利用这些技术。对于 Yves 来说，Logic Labs 可以通过这个系统提升 AI 应用的性能，进而提高其在行业中的竞争力，同时也能为 TexTale 提供更智能的电商运营和品牌营销支持。作为创意设计从业者，他可以借助这个工具来更好地整合 AI 技术，实现创意灵感的快速转化。

github_trending.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
github_trending.summary_zh:
这个项目名为 ponytail，旨在让你的 AI 助手以一种懒散的高级开发者的方式思考，强调“最好的代码就是你从未编写的代码”，也就是尽量减少人工编写的代码量。 

对 Yves 来说，这个项目可能会对 Logic Labs（AI 公司）产生帮助，因为它可以优化 AI 助手的效率，提升工作流程，使创意设计过程更加流畅高效。

github_trending.description: The agent that grows with you
github_trending.summary_zh: 这个项目是一个智能代理，能够根据用户的需求和习惯进行不断学习和适应，从而提供个性化的服务和支持。对于Yves来说，这个项目可以在Logic Labs（AI公司）中帮助提升AI模型的智能化和用户体验，也能为TexTale（科技服装电商）提供更好的客户洞察和个性化营销策略，增强品牌竞争力。作为创意设计从业者，这个工具还可以激发新的创意灵感，提升设计效率。
这个项目是一个现代化的格式化库，主要用于简化和优化文本的输出和显示，比如格式化字符串。对Yves的TexTale电商业务特别有帮助，因为在电商平台上，良好的文本格式可以提升产品展示的专业性和吸引力，同时作为创意设计从业者，他也可以利用这个工具来创建更个性化和吸引人的品牌内容。
这个项目是一个公开的代码库，主要用于开发和提升人工智能代理的技能，帮助 AI 更好地理解和完成任务。对于Yves而言，这个项目对Logic Labs（AI 公司）尤其有帮助，因为它可以为他的AI产品提供更先进的技能和能力，从而提升公司在 AI 领域的竞争力。同时，作为创意设计从业者，他可以借助这些技能生成更具创意和智能的设计方案。

github_trending.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
github_trending.summary_zh: 这个项目提供了38种不同的编辑图表类型，用户可以用它们来创建清晰的视觉内容，主要用于展示和说明信息。对Yves的Logic Labs（AI公司）有帮助，因为这些图表可以有效地展示AI解决方案的思路和结果，并提升沟通效果；同时也能为他在创意设计领域提供灵感，帮助他更好地构思和呈现自己的创意。
这个项目是一个开源的编码助手，可以帮助用户更轻松地编写和优化代码。对于Yves来说，这个工具可以在Logic Labs（AI公司）中提高开发效率，帮助团队更快地实现创意与技术的结合。同时作为创意设计从业者，使用这个工具也能为他提供编程方面的支持，推动他的创意落地。

github_trending.description: 🌊 The original agent meta-harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
github_trending.summary_zh:
这个项目是一个智能代理框架，可以部署多玩家协作，协调自主工作流程，并构建对话式 AI 系统。它具备自适应记忆、自学习智能和丰富的集成功能，适合需要高效沟通及自动化处理的场景。

对 Yves 的 Logic Labs（AI 公司）会非常有帮助，因为这个项目可以用于开发更智能的 AI 应用，提升团队协作和工作效率，同时也为 TexTale 提供思考如何运用 AI 优化电商运营和客户互动的灵感。
这个项目是一个用于识别和处理人类技能的库，可以帮助开发者创建更智能的应用，让机器更好地理解和应用人类的能力。对Yves来说，这个项目对于Logic Labs（AI 公司）非常有帮助，因为它可以为他们的AI产品提供更精准的人才技能识别，助力创意设计和品牌营销。同时，这种技能识别能力也可以增强TexTale的客户分析和个性化推荐。
